name: Epaphroditus
bio: Epaphroditus, sent by the Philippian church to minister to Paul's needs, fell dangerously ill while serving him, almost to the point of death, out of concern for the work of Christ; Paul sent him back to Philippi, both to ease his homesickness and to relieve the church's worry, urging them to receive him with joy and honor (Philippians 2:25-30, 4:18).
